issues.description: The Person.firstName field has different visibility in the template and the solution: the template declares firstName as a private field with getters/setters, while the solution declares it as public. This discrepancy is structural (field visibility) and can confuse students when comparing the template to the reference solution or when reasoning about encapsulation and use of getters/setters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of firstName consistent between template and solution. Prefer making firstName private in the solution (and keep/use the existing getters/setters) to preserve encapsulation and match the template, or explicitly document why the field is public if that was intentional.
